question: The valency of argentic is :
solution:
The correct answer is __**+2.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The valency of argentic is +2, which means it can lose two electrons to form a cation with a charge of +2.**
 
• The name **argentic is derived from the Latin word argentum, which means silver.**
 
• Valency: It is the combined capacity of an element to form bonds by sharing electron pairs to make stable chemical compounds.
 
• Therefore, the correct option is 4 (+2), which represents the valency of argentic.
 
• Silver [I] Argentous is Ag+

 Silver [II] Argentic is Ag²⁺
